newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares down 6.09 pct on Deng reports.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares down 6.09 pct on Deng reports.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index was down 9.28 points or 6.09 percent at 143.03 points in late morning trading on Tuesday.
Sentiment was soured by overseas media reports about the health of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping, brokers said.
